text:
[Council File 20-0151-S1]
Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to a proposed Amendment to Contract No. 3744 with Kompan, Inc. for the purchase and installation of playground and outdoor fitness equipment, surfacing, site accessories, and related products and services.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - AUGUST 17, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - AUGUST 14, 2026)
summary: Extend contract with Kompan, Inc. for the purchase and installation of playground and outdoor fitness equipment.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, Libraries, and Community Enrichment Committee approved item(s) (Aug 11, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 12, 2026); Council action final
